narration: Your credit card has over twelve hundred dollars in free benefits — but 73% of cardholders have never filed a single claim. The money's just sitting there.
visual: Dark background. Credit card SVG slides up from bottom with green glow. Dollar counter animates from $0 to $1,200. Text: '73% OF CARDHOLDERS NEVER CLAIM THEM'.

narration: Number one: cell phone protection. Many premium cards cover up to $800 if your screen cracks or your phone's stolen — just pay your monthly bill with the card.
visual: Light background. SVG phone with cracked red screen. Green shield animates sliding up over the phone with a checkmark. '$800' in large text.

narration: Number two: travel delay insurance. Flight stuck over six hours? Your card can cover hotel and meals — up to $350 per ticket. Wild, right?
visual: Dark background. Airplane SVG moves across frame toward a red clock showing delay. Hotel building animates rising up below. '$350' highlighted in green.

narration: Number three: purchase protection. Buy something and it breaks within 90 days — your card repairs or replaces it. No fighting with the store.
visual: Light background. Shopping bag SVG drops in with an X mark inside (broken item). Green shield scales in over the bag with checkmark. '90-DAY COVERAGE'.

narration: Number four: price protection. If the price drops within 90 days of buying, your card refunds the difference. Average claim? Over $60 back in your pocket.
visual: Dark background. Price tag SVG shows $199 animating down to $129. Down arrow appears. Green badge pops in showing 'YOU GET BACK $70'.

narration: Here's the move: flip your card over and call the number on the back. Ask what benefits are included — five minutes to find an invisible safety net you've had for years.
visual: Light background. Credit card SVG flips to show back with phone number. CTA box: 'FLIP YOUR CARD OVER / CALL THE NUMBER'. Phone icon and prompt text.
